name: hu-eli-mcp
description: Hungarian legislation with verifiable citations from the National Legislation Database (Nemzeti Jogszabalytar, njt.jog.gov.hu): national acts and decrees and municipal decrees (onkormanyzati rendeletek, e.g. local building regulations) by native ELI, read in full as paged plain text with search and point-in-time versions. Every answer carries the official source. Queries go only to njt.jog.gov.hu.
